task: How to iron a pair of pants
query: How do I iron a pair of pants?

goal.title: Iron and hang a pair of jeans
goal.description: Align the jeans on an ironing board and adjust the iron. Repeatedly turn and straighten the garment to press its front and rear sections, switching hands for the lower legs. Clip the waistband onto a hanger with two wooden pegs and hang it from the wardrobe handle.
goal.final_state: The jeans hang from a black hanger attached to the wardrobe handle, secured at the waistband with two wooden clothespins. The iron rests upright beside the ironing board.

procedure.description: Lift the jeans from the board, manipulate and align the elastic waistband, then lay one leg lengthwise on the board. Pull its hem and seams straight and sweep both hands across the fabric to flatten it.

Retrieve the iron from beside the board and adjust its upper control with the left fingers. Pull and smooth the waist, hold the white drawstring aside, make initial pressing strokes over the upper front, then smooth the long leg by hand.

Run the iron back and forth along the first front-facing leg and over the pocket and thigh while the left hand steadies the waistband. Finish toward the lower leg, lift the iron and stand it upright beside the board.

Lift and turn the jeans so a rear pocket faces up. Smooth and align the fabric, retrieve the iron and make repeated strokes over the rear pocket and down the leg. Return the iron to its upright resting position.

Lift and reorient the garment to expose the other rear-facing section. Pull the hem and seams straight, smooth the leg, steady the waist and iron over the rear pocket and upper leg. Transfer the iron into the left hand for lower-leg strokes, transfer it back and stand it upright.

Turn the garment front side up again and realign the other leg on the board. Retrieve the iron, keep the drawstring clear and press the upper front and thigh. Switch to the left hand to press toward the hem, put the iron upright and lift and spread the jeans flat on the board.

Turn to the nearby chair, collect the black hanger and two wooden clothespins and return. Position the waistband against the hanger lower bar. Squeeze and release a wooden peg to secure one side, align the opposite side and secure it with the second peg.

Lift the hanger carrying the clipped jeans, move toward the wardrobe and shift a small storage box out of the way. Close the wardrobe door with the free left hand and lower the hanger hook onto its handle. Release the hanger, leaving the jeans suspended by the two clothespins.

notes: All five overview sheets, every dense fine page and all three native endpoint sheets visually reviewed. Fine bounds preserved. Fine ends at 141.0s, ffprobe141.6s: final 0.6s is unchanged presentation of hanging jeans and no new fine added. Front/rear labels follow visible front or rear pockets; exact anatomical left/right leg is not inferred. In-hand tracks actual grasp: palm smoothing does not count, and the iron switches to left hand at about87.5s and109.3s. No new water filling, plugging, steam selection or unplugging shown. The garment is clipped to the hanger bar with two separate wooden pegs, not threaded over its bar. New subtask partitions follow complete pressing arrangements and final storage.

coarse.instruction: Arrange the jeans and prepare the iron
coarse.description: Lift and align the waistband, lay a leg along the ironing board, straighten the hem and smooth the fabric. Retrieve the iron, adjust its control and pull the upper jeans flat.
coarse.goal_contribution: Sets up the garment and tool for pressing.

coarse.description: Hold the drawstring aside, press the upper front, smooth the long leg and make repeated iron strokes along the leg and over the front pocket and thigh. Stand the iron upright after finishing.
coarse.goal_contribution: Presses the first exposed front-facing section of the jeans.
coarse.predictability_reason: After arrange the jeans and prepare the iron, iron the first front section is a natural next stage toward iron and hang a pair of jeans.

coarse.description: Turn the jeans rear side up, retrieve the iron, pull and smooth the fabric and press around the rear pocket and down the leg. Return the iron to its rest.
coarse.goal_contribution: Presses the rear surface exposed by the first turn.
coarse.predictability_reason: After iron the first front section, iron the first rear section is a natural next stage toward iron and hang a pair of jeans.

coarse.description: Lift and reorient the garment, straighten and smooth the other rear-facing leg, then press the pocket and upper leg. Switch the iron into the left hand for the lower leg, switch back and stand it upright.
coarse.goal_contribution: Extends pressing to the other rear-facing section and lower leg.
coarse.predictability_reason: After iron the first rear section, iron the other rear section is a natural next stage toward iron and hang a pair of jeans.

coarse.description: Turn the jeans front side up, straighten the leg, retrieve the iron and keep the drawstring clear. Press the upper front and thigh, switch to the left hand for the hem and put the iron aside.
coarse.goal_contribution: Finishes the front-facing section that was not pressed in the first arrangement.
coarse.predictability_reason: After iron the other rear section, iron the remaining front section is a natural next stage toward iron and hang a pair of jeans.

coarse.instruction: Clip and hang the pressed jeans
coarse.description: Lift and spread the jeans on the board, collect the hanger and two wooden pegs, and clip both sides of the waistband onto the hanger lower bar. Carry the jeans toward the wardrobe, move the storage box, close the door and hang the hanger on its handle.
coarse.goal_contribution: Stores the pressed garment suspended from its waistband.
coarse.predictability_reason: After iron the remaining front section, clip and hang the pressed jeans is a natural next stage toward iron and hang a pair of jeans.
